answer: In our network, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across transaction paths, where verifying clusters form a protective ridge that isolates suspicious nodes. If cross-audits detect conflicting state claims, bonded stake is slashed automatically. To fake an identity route, an adversary must build an outbound jetty into the cluster graph and solve an interactive cipher challenge per edge, driving attacker cost to superlinear scale.
